routing.task_class: Explicitly selected Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) coordination in GUI Codex that minimizes total wall-clock time through dependency-aware official-subagent waves, parent integration, and optional task continuity
natural_language_triggers: select the bundled Coding Agent Orchestrator skill
Use the selected Coding Agent Orchestrator plugin for this coding objective
Use Coding Agent Orchestrator for this coding objective
コーディング・エージェント・オーケストレーターでこのコーディング作業を進めて
continue this already active Coding Agent Orchestrator workflow
routing.primary_route: For a coding objective, activate only when the current request begins with uppercase CAO as an invocation prefix (CAO <objective>, CAOで<objective>, or CAO: <objective>), directly invokes $coding-agent-orchestrator, explicitly selects the bundled Coding Agent Orchestrator skill, or explicitly requests the Coding Agent Orchestrator / コーディング・エージェント・オーケストレーター workflow. The parent then maps dependencies, the critical path, readiness, concurrency, and coordination or integration cost. It spawns every ready, independent, sufficiently large responsibility in the same parallel wave when doing so reduces total time-to-completion; tightly coupled, dependency-blocked, overlapping, or too-small work remains parent-owned or ordered. The parent retains authority, safety, conflicts, integration, and acceptance. Continuation without repeating the name is limited to that active workflow.
fallback_conditions: When official collaboration tools are unavailable, stop this workflow and report the unavailable boundary without emulating delegation.
non_use_conditions: Do not treat a bare Coding Agent Orchestrator plugin attachment, plugin inspection, discovery question, or troubleshooting request as activation of the coding workflow.
Do not activate from an incidental CAO mention, a non-leading CAO occurrence, or lowercase cao; CAO is an invocation alias only at the start of the current coding request.

Do not select Coding Agent Orchestrator for generic coding, debugging, review, explanation, subagent decomposition, multi-agent coordination, or team coordination without explicit workflow selection for a coding objective.
Do not select Coding Agent Orchestrator from .coding-agent-orchestrator directory presence or prior state alone.
Do not treat a continuation outside an already active explicitly selected Coding Agent Orchestrator workflow as a trigger.

interface.short_description: Explicit GUI coding orchestration with official subagents
interface.default_prompt: Use $coding-agent-orchestrator for this coding objective: map dependencies and the critical path, spawn ready independent work in parallel, and keep parent control of integration.

inputs.name: Coding outcome and repository
inputs.description: The user-visible coding result, target repository, applicable instructions, authority boundary, and current source state.

inputs.name: Scheduling and ownership map
inputs.description: Bounded responsibilities, dependencies, critical path, readiness, expected duration, simultaneous-execution safety, coordination and integration cost, exclusive source ownership, and the parent integration boundary.

inputs.name: Worker job characteristics
inputs.description: Objective, exact scope, authoritative inputs, completed output, permissions, stop conditions, acceptance evidence, and finite descendant permission for each worker.

inputs.name: Optional continuity material
inputs.description: Current decisions, completed work, remaining dependencies, worker outcomes, blockers, and a safe resume point when a genuine pause or later continuation makes persistence useful.

outputs.name: Time-saving official-subagent waves
outputs.description: Ready, independent, sufficiently large worker jobs dispatched without serial delay in the same wave when their expected elapsed-time saving exceeds coordination and integration cost.

outputs.name: Integrated coding result
outputs.description: Parent-integrated source or artifacts with one task-sized acceptance decision and concise user-facing handoff.

outputs.name: Optional continuity note
outputs.description: A minimal parent-maintained context file used only when persistence materially helps; its format does not control acceptance.

worker_owner: acceptance evidence for the owned output
workflow_contract.scheduling_rule: Minimize total time-to-completion rather than agent count. Spawn all ready independent work in the same wave only when each responsibility is large enough to save real elapsed time after coordination and integration cost; keep tightly coupled, blocked, overlapping, or too-small work parent-owned or ordered.
workflow_contract.non_role_rule: Do not create validator-only, reviewer-only, state-formatting, or duplicate-investigation roles. State and verification remain the minimum support needed for implementation and task acceptance.
workflow_contract.acceptance_rule: Use one task-sized semantic acceptance bundle; success ends verification, and a concrete failure returns only the affected scope to its owner.
